描述_EN: xing and ding wares were both made in kilns in the hebei province of china during the northern song dynasty (960-1127). porcelains differ from other ceramics in their impermeability, their whiteness and fine texture. the term porcelain is applied to ceramics made from a mixture containing a of clay called kaolin and a white stone called petuntse, which was fired at high temperatures. although they look very similar, subtle differences in the glaze and the body of these dishes can link them to the wares produced in their respective places of origin, the cities of xing yao and ding yao. xing and ding wares were of the earliest true porcelains made in china, and the world. these two dishes are examples of xing ware (left) and ding ware (right).
描述_ZN: 北宋时期（960-1127年），中国河北的窑厂都在生产兴和鼎的器物。 瓷器与其他陶瓷的不同之处在于其不渗透性、白色和精细的纹理。 瓷器这一术语适用于由含有一种叫做高岭土的粘土和一种叫做petuntse的白色石头的混合物制成的陶瓷，在高温下烧制。 虽然它们看起来非常相似，但这些餐具的釉面和器身的细微差别可以将它们与它们各自的产地--兴耀和定耀--生产的器物联系起来。 邢、定二器是中国乃至世界上最早的真正的瓷器。 这两个盘子是邢器（左）和鼎器（右）的例子。
